clause_appends.REQ-DEVICE-RACKS-005: Rack view selectors show or hide eligible Macro Controls, Chain List and Devices views, with Pad View unique to Drum Racks; hiding all views, context Fold or title double-click folds the Rack. Right-clicking the Device View selector offers a hierarchical device list whose selected entry is selected and revealed. With Chain List focused, up/down changes selection; dragging and hovering a selected chain over a Session or Arrangement track gives it focus and opens Device View. Rack and chain Rename use Edit; Info Text uses Edit or context, and chain color uses its context palette. Entire chains can be saved/recalled as browser presets without a specified save/recall gesture; file/geometry/timing outcomes remain U.
clause_appends.REQ-DEVICE-RACKS-007: Key, Velocity and Chain buttons select their editors; Hide hides them. Main and fade sections resize from left/right edges and move by interior drags; the Chain selector indicator is draggable. Exact gesture geometry and boundary arithmetic remain U.
clause_appends.REQ-DEVICE-RACKS-015: The Show/Hide Macro Variations selector exposes the variations view. Launch Macro Variation and Overwrite Macro Variation are separate buttons; Edit/context commands manage selected entries.
clause_appends.REQ-DEVICE-RACKS-016: The Receive list presents note names, MIDI note numbers and standard GM drum equivalents; no complete translation table is inferred.
clause_appends.REQ-DEVICE-RACKS-018: Independently compatible browser instruments and presets can also be dropped onto pads; this does not establish arbitrary browser-object admission or new sample-dropping defaults.
clause_appends.REQ-DEVICE-RACKS-020: The pad overview can be dragged or navigated with focused up/down keys; Alt Windows/Cmd macOS shifts by single rows. Empty-pad hover shows note and suggested GM instrument in Status Bar. One-chain pads also expose mute, solo, preview and delete. In active Hot-Swap, focused D switches the target between the Drum Rack and last selected pad; no global key exception or rollback is implied.
